item.title: Why young Africans still listen to the radio
item.description:
"Discover the enduring appeal of radio in modern Africa. Tune in to 'Why Young Africans Still Listen to the Radio' as we explore the surprising reasons behind radio's persistent popularity among Africa's youth." (155 characters, including spaces)
Alternatively, a shorter version: "Africa's youth still tune in: exploring radio's enduring appeal" (127 characters, including spaces)
